interface.name: tilo_text_input_manager_v1
interface.description: An opt-in field owned by the requesting client's wl_surface. Text still travels through zwp_text_input_v3; this protocol carries only opaque original-field stamps, admission metadata and insertion outcomes. It grants no input-method ownership, microphone access or cross-origin access.

entry.name: invalid_snapshot
entry.summary: snapshot must be empty or exactly 32 bytes

entry.name: prepare
entry.summary: enable the original field for the existing input method

entry.name: start
entry.summary: validate the original field after explicit consent

entry.name: final
entry.summary: the next standard IME commit belongs to this original request

entry.name: cancel
entry.summary: retire only the request with this original serial

entry.name: rejected
entry.summary: the operation is known not to have edited

entry.name: unknown
entry.summary: delivery cannot be confirmed; never retry automatically

request.name: update

description.summary: publish only an ephemeral field equality stamp

request.description: An empty snapshot disables private admission. A 32-byte snapshot is keyed, ephemeral equality metadata for the focused eligible subfield, never its contents or a persistent text hash. Changes retire original admissions. A field must remain bound to this same surface throughout.

request.name: acknowledge
request.description: Serial must identify an outstanding event on this object. Late, duplicate or retired replies cannot complete another request. A final is acknowledged after the actual asynchronous renderer result, not when standard text-input delivery is received. There is no text here.
